decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate builds directly on the firm's agricultural crate and injection-moulding know-how, so even without recent website visibility the firm can interpret harvest-season results and keep refining it in-house.
Foldable large containers are a core competence for automotive and industrial customers, and the firm's deep related knowledge lets it absorb customer feedback and improve the multi-model line.
The medium-duty rackable pallet extends established pallet engineering serving pooling and industrial demand, so its performance is easy to read and adjust with existing capabilities.
The pallet with load retainers is a modest variant of existing pallets that costs little to maintain, though its narrow niche and lack of recent visibility raise some risk of consolidation.
